title: Ensemble machine learning on cfDNA fragmentomics detects early colorectal cancer and advanced adenoma
summary: An ensemble of five machine-learning models on five cfDNA fragmentomic features was trained on 310 participants and tested in an independent cohort of 311 (149 early CRC, 46 advanced adenoma, 116 controls). It reached an AUC of 0.988, with sensitivity of 95.7% for advanced adenoma and 98.0% for early CRC at 94.8% specificity. Letter; case-control design without a screening-population cohort.
